# anthropic_federation_issuer (Data Source)

Get a single federation issuer (`fdis_…`) by ID. Requires the provider's `oauth_token`.

~> **Experimental (beta).** The Workload Identity Federation endpoints are not exercised by the provider's CI acceptance tests. Treat as beta.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_federation_issuer" "example" {
  id = "fdis_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the federation issuer (`fdis_…`).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 archive datetime, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation datetime.
- `issuer_url` (String) The `iss` claim value the issuer's JWTs carry.
- `jwks` (Attributes) How Anthropic fetches the provider's signing keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jwks))
- `name` (String) Name of the issuer.

<a id="nestedatt--jwks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jwks`

Read-Only:

- `keys_json` (String) JSON array of JWK objects (inline mode).
- `type` (String) `discovery`, `explicit_url`, or `inline`.
- `url` (String) JWKS endpoint URL (explicit_url mode).
